input.description: All 215,488 anonymous initial periodic structures; only species, initial Cartesian positions, cell vectors and periodic flags.
154,718 released MP compositions and formation energies in eV/atom for training or internal development.
89 elemental energy zeroes in eV/atom for the frozen formation-energy convention.
Allowed frozen CHGNet-0.3.0 checkpoint, scientific model card and BSD-3-Clause license.
Fields, energy conventions, scientific workflow, limitations and attribution.
All anonymous test IDs with blank formation-energy predictions.

instructions: Develop a method to predict the final MP2020-corrected formation energy in eV/atom from each of 215,488 initial WBM crystal structures. The evaluator converts predicted formation energies to stability decisions relative to the frozen Materials Project reference convex hull: a prediction at or below the reference hull energy is stable. True stability uses the released signed distance at or below 0 eV/atom, without rounding. Improve F1 on the fixed unique-prototype test subset. You receive initial geometries, 154,718 independent MP composition/formation-energy training records, 89 elemental energy references, and an allowed frozen CHGNet-0.3.0 energy/force/stress model. These resources support relaxation, calibrated energy prediction and uncertainty-aware stability methods. Test hull energies and labels are unavailable to research. CHGNet was trained on MP2020-corrected energies: do not apply the same correction twice to its predictions. This target concerns zero-temperature DFT thermodynamic stability; it does not establish synthesis feasibility or finite-temperature stability.
requirement: Use only the scientific datasets and pretrained checkpoints explicitly supplied in input. Scientific literature and algorithm ideas may be used, but no additional model weights, training datasets or sample-specific answers may be introduced into this resource track.

Do not retrieve or use public test target tables, relaxed test reference structures, source ID mappings or archived per-sample benchmark predictions. Do not select a method, checkpoint, hyperparameter or subset using hidden test labels.

Submit all and only the template IDs exactly once in the declared submission.csv. No extra columns or files, duplicate IDs, missing rows, blanks, NaN or infinity are accepted. Use strict UTF-8 decimal values without surrounding spaces; each numerical field is at most 128 characters.
The score covers the entire frozen test set. Internal calculation failures need a label-free finite fallback; samples cannot be dropped. Units are interpreted literally without automatic conversion.

Retain executable research code, dependency versions and training-data/model-source disclosures for reproducibility review. Public source data and anonymous identifiers do not establish absence of pretraining contamination.
The submitted CSV may not exceed 33554432 bytes.

submission.description: Exactly material_id,e_form_eV_per_atom. One finite MP2020-corrected formation energy in eV/atom per test ID.
